newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridania down on 1997 profit statement.
newsitem.headline: Eridania down on 1997 profit statement.

text.p: Shares in Eridania Beghin-Say fell on Monday as the market responded negatively to the agro-food company's cautious 1997 results outlook, dealers said.
At 1242 GMT Eridania was down 23 francs or 2.53 percent at 887 francs on volume of 21,922 shares.
"The 1997 forecasts are not very good; they are below analysts' estimates," a Paris dealer said.
The Franco-Italian food giant on Friday predicted stable to slightly higher operating profit this year after reporting a 6.2 percent decline in 1996 earnings.

Eridania's operating income fell to 3.752 billion francs in 1996 from 4.001 billion the year before. But net attributable profit rose to a better than expected 1.660 billion from 1.526 billion. Some analysts had been looking for 1.535 to 1.565 billion net income in 1996 and 1.615 to 1.625 billion in 1997.
Dealers said word from the stock exchange that European Sugars France, part of Montedison, now held more than two thirds of Eridania voting rights had not affected shares.
The move, which need not automatically trigger a bid, followed an international reorganisation of shareholdings.
